1556: maps, rather than supplied as a compatibility hypothesis. -/

1557: theorem w6_actual_transpose_lower_right_is_carrier_frequency {n d : Nat}
1558:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) :
1559:     ∃ (C : Submodule F (W n))
1560:       (hBC : IsCompl (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') C)
1561:       (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F]
1562:         (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') ×
1563:           LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin')
1564:       (D : Submodule F (V d))
1565:       (hAD : IsCompl (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') D)
1566:       (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F]
1567:         (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') ×
1568:           (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin')),
1569:       ∀ b : LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin',
1570:         (eV (Y.transpose.toLin' (eW.symm (0, b)))).2 =
1571:           w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y b := by
1572:   classical
1573:   obtain ⟨C, hBC, eW, hW⟩ :=
1574:     w6_actual_transpose_domain_image_kernel_equiv X
1575:   obtain ⟨D, hAD, eV, hV⟩ :=
1576:     w6_actual_transpose_codomain_image_quotient_equiv X

1578:   intro b

1580:     apply Subtype.ext
1581:     exact b.property
1582:   have hsecond :
1583:       (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin').projectionOnto C hBC b = b :=
1584:     Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_left hBC b
1585:   have hbsymm : eW.symm (0, b) = b := by
1586:     apply eW.injective
1587:     rw [eW.apply_symm_apply, hW]
1588:     simp [hfirst, hsecond]
1589:   rw [hbsymm]
1590:   have hpair := congrArg Prod.snd (hV (Y.transpose.toLin' b))
1591:   simpa [w6ActualCarrierFrequency, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hpair

1593: /-- The three actual carrier dimensions are determined by the ambient matrix
1594: rank and the two ambient dimensions. -/
1595: theorem w6_actual_transpose_carrier_dimensions {n d : Nat}
1596:     (X : BinaryMatrix n d) :
1597:     Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') = X.rank ∧
1598:     Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') = n - X.rank ∧
1599:     Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') = d - X.rank := by
1600:   have hA :
1601:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') = X.rank := by
1602:     have h := Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin X.transpose
1603:       (Pi.basisFun F _) (Pi.basisFun F _)
1604:     rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin'] at h
1605:     exact h.symm.trans (Matrix.rank_transpose X)
1606:   have hW : Module.finrank F (W n) = n := by simp
1607:   have hV : Module.finrank F (V d) = d := by simp
1608:   have hnull := X.transpose.toLin'.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
1609:   have hnull' : X.rank +
1610:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') = n := by
1611:     simpa only [hA, hW] using hnull
1612:   have hB :
1613:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') = n - X.rank := by
1614:     omega
1615:   have hquot :=
1616:     (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin').finrank_quotient_add_finrank
1617:   change Module.finrank F
1618:       (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') +
1619:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') =
1620:       Module.finrank F (V d) at hquot
1621:   have hquot' :
1622:       Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') + X.rank = d := by
1623:     simpa only [hA, hV] using hquot
1624:   have hQ :
1625:       Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') = d - X.rank := by
1626:     omega
1627:   exact ⟨hA, hB, hQ⟩

1633:     (X : BinaryMatrix n d) :
1634:     ∃ (C : Submodule F (W n))

1636:       (D : Submodule F (V d))
1637:       (hAD : IsCompl (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') D)
1638:       (bA : Module.Basis (Fin X.rank) F (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
1639:       (bB : Module.Basis (Fin (n - X.rank)) F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin'))
1640:       (bQ : Module.Basis (Fin (d - X.rank)) F
1641:         (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
1642:       (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F]
1643:         ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (n - X.rank) → F)))
1644:       (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F]
1645:         ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (d - X.rank) → F))),
1646:       (∀ w, eW w =
1647:         (bA.equivFun (X.transpose.toLin'.rangeRestrict w),
1648:           bB.equivFun ((LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin').projectionOnto C hBC w))) ∧

1650:         (bA.equivFun ((LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin').projectionOnto D hAD v),

1655:     w6_actual_transpose_domain_image_kernel_equiv X

1659:     (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') hA

1661:     (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') hB

1663:     (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') hQ

1667:   · intro w
1668:     change (LinearEquiv.prodCongr bA.equivFun bB.equivFun) (eW0 w) = _

1746: /-- Express `Yᵀ` in the one fixed finite coordinate package chosen from `X`.
1747: The row/column indices are sums, so its four blocks have exactly the types
1748: used by the fixed-`Z` predecessor fiber. -/
1749: def w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix {n d k m s : Nat}
1750:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin m → F)))
1751:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin s → F)))
1752:     (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) : Matrix (Fin k ⊕ Fin s) (Fin k ⊕ Fin m) F := by
1753:   let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin m) F F
1754:   let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin s) F F
1755:   let eWsum := eW.trans eIn.symm
1756:   let eVsum := eV.trans eOut.symm
1757:   exact LinearMap.toMatrix'
1758:     (eVsum.toLinearMap.comp

1761: /-- The linear equivalence on matrix spaces induced by the fixed domain and
1762: codomain coordinate equivalences. -/
1763: private def w6ActualFiniteCoordinateLinearEquiv {n d k m s : Nat}
1764:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin m → F)))
1765:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin s → F))) :
1766:     Matrix (Fin d) (Fin n) F ≃ₗ[F]
1767:       Matrix (Fin k ⊕ Fin s) (Fin k ⊕ Fin m) F := by
1768:   let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin m) F F
1769:   let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin s) F F
1770:   let eWsum := eW.trans eIn.symm
1771:   let eVsum := eV.trans eOut.symm

1773:     ((LinearEquiv.arrowCongr eWsum eVsum).trans Matrix.toLin'.symm)

1777: theorem w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_eq_equiv

1788:   let eVsum := eV.trans eOut.symm

1790:       (eVsum.toLinearMap.comp
1791:         (Y.transpose.toLin'.comp eWsum.symm.toLinearMap)) =
1792:     LinearMap.toMatrix'
1793:       ((LinearEquiv.arrowCongr eWsum eVsum) (Matrix.toLin' Y.transpose))

1796: /-- The shared-coordinate matrix equivalence preserves rank. -/
1797: theorem w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_rank
1798:     {n d k m s : Nat}
1799:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin m → F)))
1800:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin s → F)))
1801:     (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) :
1802:     (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).rank = Y.rank := by
1803:   classical
1804:   let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin m) F F
1805:   let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin s) F F
1806:   let eWsum := eW.trans eIn.symm
1807:   let eVsum := eV.trans eOut.symm
1808:   let L := Matrix.toLin' Y.transpose
1809:   let C := eVsum.toLinearMap.comp (L.comp eWsum.symm.toLinearMap)
1810:   have hrange : LinearMap.range C = (LinearMap.range L).map eVsum.toLinearMap := by
1811:     ext y
1812:     constructor
1813:     · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
1814:       apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
1815:       refine ⟨L (eWsum.symm x), ?_, rfl⟩
1816:       exact ⟨eWsum.symm x, rfl⟩
1817:     · intro hy
1818:       rcases Submodule.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩
1819:       rcases hz with ⟨x, rfl⟩
1820:       refine ⟨eWsum x, ?_⟩
1821:       change eVsum (L (eWsum.symm (eWsum x))) = y
1822:       rw [eWsum.symm_apply_apply]
1823:       exact hzy
1824:   have hdim : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range C) =
1825:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range L) := by
1826:     rw [hrange]
1827:     exact eVsum.finrank_map_eq (LinearMap.range L)
1828:   have hsrc : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range L) = Y.rank := by
1829:     have h := Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin Y.transpose
1830:       (Pi.basisFun F _) (Pi.basisFun F _)
1831:     rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin'] at h
1832:     exact h.symm.trans (Matrix.rank_transpose Y)
1833:   have hcoord : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range C) =
1834:       (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).rank := by
1835:     have h := Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin
1836:       (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y)
1837:       (Pi.basisFun F _) (Pi.basisFun F _)
1838:     rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin'] at h
1839:     change (LinearMap.toMatrix' C).rank =
1840:       Module.finrank F
1841:         (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' (LinearMap.toMatrix' C))) at h
1842:     have hdim := congrArg
1843:       (fun L : (Fin k ⊕ Fin m → F) →ₗ[F] (Fin k ⊕ Fin s → F) =>
1844:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range L))
1845:       (Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix' C)
1846:     have h' := h.trans hdim
1847:     change Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range C) =
1848:       (LinearMap.toMatrix' C).rank
1849:     exact h'.symm
1850:   calc
1851:     (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).rank =
1852:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range C) := hcoord.symm
1853:     _ = Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range L) := hdim
1854:     _ = Y.rank := hsrc

1856: /-- A single fixed pair of actual coordinates gives a bijection from ambient
1857: matrices to the full four-block coordinate matrices. -/
1858: def w6ActualFiniteCoordinateEquiv {n d k m s : Nat}
1859:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin m → F)))
1860:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin s → F))) :
1861:     BinaryMatrix n d ≃ Matrix (Fin k ⊕ Fin s) (Fin k ⊕ Fin m) F where
1862:   toFun := w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV
1863:   invFun M := (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateLinearEquiv eW eV).symm M |>.transpose
1864:   left_inv Y := by
1865:     change ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateLinearEquiv eW eV).symm
1866:       (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y)).transpose = Y
1867:     rw [w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_eq_equiv]
1868:     simp [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
1869:   right_inv M := by
1870:     change w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV
1871:       ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateLinearEquiv eW eV).symm M).transpose = M
1872:     rw [w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_eq_equiv]
1873:     simp [Matrix.transpose_transpose]

1891: /-- Evaluation of the conjugated matrix is exactly evaluation in the chosen
1892: actual image/kernel coordinates. -/
1893: theorem w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_apply
1894:     {n d k m s : Nat}
1895:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin m → F)))
1896:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin s → F)))
1897:     (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (a : Fin k → F) (b : Fin m → F) :
1898:     let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin m) F F

1900:     eOut ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).mulVecLin (eIn.symm (a, b))) =
1901:       eV (Y.transpose.toLin' (eW.symm (a, b))) := by
1902:   dsimp only
1903:   simp [w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
1904:     Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
1905:     LinearEquiv.trans_symm, LinearMap.comp_apply]

1907: /-- The fixed `X` matrix becomes the identity on the image block and zero on
1908: the quotient block in the same conjugated matrix coordinates. -/
1909: theorem w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_X
1910:     {n d k m s : Nat}
1911:     (X : BinaryMatrix n d)
1912:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin m → F)))
1913:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin k → F) × (Fin s → F)))
1914:     (hX : ∀ (a : Fin k → F) (b : Fin m → F),
1915:       eV (X.transpose.toLin' (eW.symm (a, b))) = (a, 0)) :
1916:     w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV X =
1917:       Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) F) 0 0 0 := by
1918:   classical
1919:   let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin m) F F
1920:   let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow (Fin k) (Fin s) F F
1921:   apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
1922:   apply LinearMap.ext
1923:   intro v
1924:   have hv : v = eIn.symm (eIn v) := (eIn.symm_apply_apply v).symm
1925:   rw [hv]
1926:   apply eOut.injective
1927:   change eOut ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV X).mulVecLin
1928:       (eIn.symm (eIn v))) =
1929:     eOut ((Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) F) 0 0 0).mulVecLin
1930:       (eIn.symm (eIn v)))
1931:   rw [w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_apply]
1932:   apply Prod.ext
1933:   · funext a
1934:     rw [LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow_apply_fst]
1935:     have hx := congrArg Prod.fst (hX (eIn v).1 (eIn v).2)
1936:     simpa [eIn, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec,
1937:       LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow_symm_apply_inl,
1938:       LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow_symm_apply_inr] using congrFun hx a
1939:   · funext b
1940:     rw [LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow_apply_snd]
1941:     have hx := congrArg Prod.snd (hX (eIn v).1 (eIn v).2)
1942:     simpa [eIn, Matrix.fromBlocks_mulVec,
1943:       LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow_symm_apply_inl,
1944:       LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow_symm_apply_inr] using congrFun hx b

1946: /-- With the same fixed coordinates, the lower-right action of every ambient
1947: transpose matrix is its actual carrier-frequency map. -/
1948: theorem w6_actual_fixed_x_bottom_coordinate_identity {n d : Nat}
1949:     (X : BinaryMatrix n d) :
1950:     ∃ (C : Submodule F (W n))
1951:       (hBC : IsCompl (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') C)
1952:       (D : Submodule F (V d))
1953:       (hAD : IsCompl (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') D)
1954:       (bA : Module.Basis (Fin X.rank) F (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
1955:       (bB : Module.Basis (Fin (n - X.rank)) F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin'))
1956:       (bQ : Module.Basis (Fin (d - X.rank)) F
1957:         (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
1958:       (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (n - X.rank) → F)))
1959:       (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (d - X.rank) → F))),
1960:       ∀ (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (b : Fin (n - X.rank) → F),
1961:         let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
1962:           (Fin X.rank) (Fin (n - X.rank)) F F
1963:         let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
1964:           (Fin X.rank) (Fin (d - X.rank)) F F
1965:         (eOut ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).mulVecLin
1966:           (eIn.symm (0, b)))).2 =
1967:           bQ.equivFun
1968:             (w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y (bB.equivFun.symm b)) := by
1969:   obtain ⟨C, hBC, D, hAD, bA, bB, bQ, eW, eV, hX, hY⟩ :=
1970:     w6_actual_fixed_x_finite_block_identities X
1971:   refine ⟨C, hBC, D, hAD, bA, bB, bQ, eW, eV, ?_⟩
1972:   intro Y b
1973:   have happ := w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_apply eW eV Y 0 b
1974:   exact (congrArg Prod.snd happ).trans (hY Y b)

1977: /-- Under the original rank-additive predecessor relation, the actual
1978: quotient carrier map has exactly the rank of `Y-X`.  Quotienting loses no
1979: part of the `(Y-X)ᵀ` image because the two transpose images are disjoint, and
1980: restriction-surjectivity recovers that full image from `ker Xᵀ`. -/
1981: theorem w6_precedes_actual_carrier_frequency_rank {n d : Nat}
1982:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (hXY : w6Precedes X Y) :
1983:     Module.finrank F
1984:         (LinearMap.range (w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y)) = (Y - X).rank := by
1985:   let f := w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y
1986:   let g := (Y - X).transpose.toLin'.comp
1987:     (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin').subtype
1988:   let R := (Y - X).transpose.toLin'
1989:   let A := LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'
1990:   obtain ⟨_, hint⟩ := w6_precedes_transpose_range_decomposition X Y hXY
1991:   have hsum : Y.transpose.toLin' = X.transpose.toLin' + R := by
1992:     have hmatrix : Y.transpose = X.transpose + (Y - X).transpose := by
1993:       ext i j
1994:       simp
1995:     rw [hmatrix]
1996:     exact map_add (Matrix.toLin') X.transpose (Y - X).transpose
1997:   have hfg : f = A.mkQ.comp g := by
1998:     ext v
1999:     change A.mkQ (Y.transpose.toLin' (v : W n)) =
2000:       A.mkQ (R (v : W n))
2001:     have hv : X.transpose.toLin' (v : W n) = 0 := v.property
2002:     calc
2003:       A.mkQ (Y.transpose.toLin' (v : W n)) =
2004:           A.mkQ (X.transpose.toLin' (v : W n) + R (v : W n)) := by
2005:             rw [hsum, LinearMap.add_apply]
2006:       _ = A.mkQ (R (v : W n)) := by rw [hv]; simp
2007:   have hker : LinearMap.ker f = LinearMap.ker g := by
2008:     ext v
2009:     constructor
2010:     · intro hv
2011:       have hfgv := congrArg (fun L : _ →ₗ[F] _ => L v) hfg
2012:       have hv0 : f v = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv
2013:       have hq : A.mkQ (g v) = 0 := by
2014:         rw [hfgv] at hv0
2015:         exact hv0
2016:       have hX : g v ∈ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin' := by
2017:         have hmem : g v ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mkQ := LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hq
2018:         simpa [A, Submodule.ker_mkQ] using hmem
2019:       have hR : g v ∈ LinearMap.range R := LinearMap.mem_range_self R (v : W n)
2020:       have hz : g v ∈ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin' ⊓ LinearMap.range R := ⟨hX, hR⟩
2021:       rw [hint] at hz
2022:       have hz0 : g v = 0 := by simpa using hz
2023:       exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hz0
2024:     · intro hv
2025:       have hv0 : g v = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv
2026:       apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
2027:       change f v = 0
2028:       rw [hfg]
2029:       simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hv0]
2030:   have hrestriction := (w6_precedes_restriction_surjectivity X Y hXY).2
2031:   have hgrange : LinearMap.range g = LinearMap.range R := by
2032:     ext z
2033:     constructor
2034:     · intro hz
2035:       rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hz with ⟨v, hv⟩
2036:       rw [← hv]
2037:       exact LinearMap.mem_range_self R (v : W n)
2038:     · intro hz
2039:       rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hz with ⟨w, hw⟩
2040:       obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hrestriction ⟨R w, ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩
2041:       refine LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨v, ?_⟩
2042:       change R (v : W n) = z
2043:       calc
2044:         R (v : W n) = R w := hv
2045:         _ = z := hw
2046:   have hdimF := f.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
2047:   have hdimG : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range g) +
2048:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker g) =
2049:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') := by
2050:     change Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range g) +
2051:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker g) =
2052:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin')
2053:     exact g.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
2054:   have hdimFG : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range f) =
2055:       Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range g) := by
2056:     rw [hker] at hdimF
2057:     omega
2058:   have hdimR : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range R) = (Y - X).rank := by
2059:     have h := Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin (Y - X).transpose
2060:       (Pi.basisFun F _) (Pi.basisFun F _)
2061:     rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin'] at h
2062:     exact h.symm.trans (Matrix.rank_transpose (Y - X))
2063:   calc
2064:     Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range f) = Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range g) := hdimFG
2065:     _ = Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range R) := by rw [hgrange]
2066:     _ = (Y - X).rank := hdimR

2068: /-- The original ambient predecessor condition yields the A3 graph form in
2069: the fixed coordinates chosen from `X`. The lower-right block is the actual
2070: quotient carrier map, whose rank is derived from `hXY`; it is then factored
2071: through its rank and the fixed-block graph argument recovers both parameters.

2073: theorem w6_actual_predecessor_graph_factorization {n d : Nat}
2074:     (X : BinaryMatrix n d) :
2075:     ∃ (C : Submodule F (W n))
2076:       (hBC : IsCompl (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin') C)
2077:       (D : Submodule F (V d))
2078:       (hAD : IsCompl (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin') D)
2079:       (bA : Module.Basis (Fin X.rank) F (LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
2080:       (bB : Module.Basis (Fin (n - X.rank)) F (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin'))
2081:       (bQ : Module.Basis (Fin (d - X.rank)) F
2082:         (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
2083:       (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (n - X.rank) → F)))
2084:       (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F] ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (d - X.rank) → F))),
2085:       (∀ a b, eV (X.transpose.toLin' (eW.symm (a, b))) = (a, 0)) ∧
2086:       (∀ (Y' : BinaryMatrix n d) (b : Fin (n - X.rank) → F),
2087:         (let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2088:           (Fin X.rank) (Fin (n - X.rank)) F F
2089:         let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2090:           (Fin X.rank) (Fin (d - X.rank)) F F
2091:         (eOut ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y').mulVecLin
2092:           (eIn.symm (0, b)))).2 =
2093:           bQ.equivFun
2094:             (w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y' (bB.equivFun.symm b)))) ∧
2095:       ∀ (Y : BinaryMatrix n d), w6Precedes X Y →
2096:         ∃ (j : Matrix (Fin (d - X.rank)) (Fin (Y - X).rank) F)
2097:           (p : Matrix (Fin (Y - X).rank) (Fin (n - X.rank)) F)
2098:           (u : Matrix (Fin X.rank) (Fin (Y - X).rank) F)
2099:           (c : Matrix (Fin (Y - X).rank) (Fin X.rank) F),
2100:           Function.Injective (Matrix.mulVecLin j) ∧
2101:           Function.Surjective (Matrix.mulVecLin p) ∧
2102:           w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y =
2103:             w6CanonicalBlockCandidate u c j p := by
2104:   classical
2105:   obtain ⟨C, hBC, D, hAD, bA, bB, bQ, eW, eV, hX, hY⟩ :=
2106:     w6_actual_fixed_x_finite_block_identities X
2107:   have hYcoord : ∀ (Y' : BinaryMatrix n d) (b : Fin (n - X.rank) → F),
2108:       (let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2109:         (Fin X.rank) (Fin (n - X.rank)) F F
2110:       let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2111:         (Fin X.rank) (Fin (d - X.rank)) F F
2112:       (eOut ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y').mulVecLin
2113:         (eIn.symm (0, b)))).2 =
2114:         bQ.equivFun (w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y' (bB.equivFun.symm b))) := by
2115:     intro Y' b
2116:     let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2117:       (Fin X.rank) (Fin (n - X.rank)) F F
2118:     let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2119:       (Fin X.rank) (Fin (d - X.rank)) F F
2120:     have happ := w6_actual_finite_coordinate_matrix_apply eW eV Y' 0 b
2121:     exact (congrArg Prod.snd happ).trans (hY Y' b)
2122:   refine ⟨C, hBC, D, hAD, bA, bB, bQ, eW, eV, hX, hYcoord, ?_⟩
2123:   intro Y hXY
2124:   let M := w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y
2125:   let a := M.toBlocks₁₁
2126:   let b := M.toBlocks₁₂
2127:   let c := M.toBlocks₂₁
2128:   let z := M.toBlocks₂₂
2129:   have hM : M = Matrix.fromBlocks a b c z :=
2130:     (Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks M).symm
2131:   have hbase : w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV X =

2513:       rw [hYrank, hdiff]
2514:     have hbottom : (w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).toBlocks₂₂ = z := by

2516:       rfl
2517:     have hfreq := w6_actual_predecessor_frequency_eq_of_coordinate_matrix_eq
2518:       X eW eV bB bQ hYcoord Y Z hbottom

2520:   refine ⟨forward, backward, ?_, ?_⟩
2521:   · intro y
2522:     apply Subtype.ext
2523:     apply E.injective
2524:     dsimp [backward, forward]
2525:     have hM := w6_actual_predecessor_bottom_block_eq_frequency_matrix
2526:       X eW eV bB bQ hYcoord y.1
2527:     have hbottom : (E y.1).toBlocks₂₂ = z := by
2528:       simpa [z, E, w6ActualFiniteCoordinateEquiv, y.2.2] using hM
2529:     change E (E.symm (Matrix.fromBlocks
2530:       (E y.1).toBlocks₁₁ (E y.1).toBlocks₁₂
2531:       (E y.1).toBlocks₂₁ z)) = E y.1
2532:     rw [E.apply_symm_apply]
2533:     rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_toBlocks (E y.1)]
2534:     rw [hbottom]
2535:     rfl
2536:   · intro t

2542: /-- Every genuine fixed-frequency ambient predecessor fiber has the exact
2543: `2^(2*k*l)` multiplicity. -/
2544: theorem w6_actual_predecessor_frequency_fiber_card_of_coordinates
2545:     {n d l : Nat} (X : BinaryMatrix n d)
2546:     (eW : W n ≃ₗ[F]
2547:       ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (n - X.rank) → F)))
2548:     (eV : V d ≃ₗ[F]
2549:       ((Fin X.rank → F) × (Fin (d - X.rank) → F)))
2550:     (bB : Module.Basis (Fin (n - X.rank)) F
2551:       (LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin'))
2552:     (bQ : Module.Basis (Fin (d - X.rank)) F
2553:       (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
2554:     (hX : ∀ (a : Fin X.rank → F) (b : Fin (n - X.rank) → F),
2555:       eV (X.transpose.toLin' (eW.symm (a, b))) = (a, 0))
2556:     (hYcoord : ∀ (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (b : Fin (n - X.rank) → F),
2557:       let eIn := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2558:         (Fin X.rank) (Fin (n - X.rank)) F F
2559:       let eOut := LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
2560:         (Fin X.rank) (Fin (d - X.rank)) F F
2561:       (eOut ((w6ActualFiniteCoordinateMatrix eW eV Y).mulVecLin
2562:         (eIn.symm (0, b)))).2 =
2563:         bQ.equivFun
2564:           (w6ActualCarrierFrequency X Y (bB.equivFun.symm b)))
2565:     (Z : LinearMap.ker X.transpose.toLin' →ₗ[F]
2566:       (V d ⧸ LinearMap.range X.transpose.toLin'))
2567:     (hZ : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range Z) = l) :
2568:     Fintype.card (w6ActualPredecessorFrequencyFiber X Z) =
2569:       2 ^ (2 * X.rank * l) := by
2570:   classical
2571:   let z := w6ActualCarrierFrequencyCoordinateMatrix X bB bQ Z
2572:   have hz : z.rank = l := by
2573:     rw [w6_actual_carrier_frequency_coordinate_matrix_rank]
2574:     exact hZ

2576:     X eW eV bB bQ hX hYcoord Z hZ

2580:       Fintype.card_congr e

2582:       exact w6_fixed_z_block_fiber_card z hz

8: /-! Rank-additive predecessors at a fixed frequency.  This module starts the
9: actual matrix-to-projection adapter used by the W6 predecessor count; it does
10: not import the uncompiled GrassmannCounting draft. -/
11: 
12: namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A7PredecessorCount
13: 
14: open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A7WeightedPredecessor
15: open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualTypedABBottomTopRankReindex
16: open PvNP.RealizableHardness.BinaryMatrixFourier

19: set_option autoImplicit false
20: noncomputable section
21: attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
22: attribute [local instance] Fintype.ofFinite
23: 
24: private abbrev F := ZMod 2
25: private abbrev V (d : Nat) := Fin d → F
26: private abbrev W (n : Nat) := Fin n → F
27: 
28: /-- The transposed linear map represented by a matrix in the manuscript's
29: `W n → V d` convention. -/
30: def transposeMap {n d : Nat} (M : BinaryMatrix n d) : W n →ₗ[F] V d :=
31:   M.transpose.toLin'
32: 
33: private theorem transposeMap_rank {n d : Nat} (M : BinaryMatrix n d) :
34:     Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range (transposeMap M)) = M.rank := by
35:   change Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range M.transpose.toLin') = M.rank
36:   rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose M]
37:   rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin M.transpose
38:     (Pi.basisFun F _) (Pi.basisFun F _)]
39:   rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin']
40: 
41: /-- Rank additivity makes the two transposed image subspaces disjoint and
42: their sum exactly the image of the parent map.  The map direction is
43: `W n → V d`, since `M.transpose.toLin'` is the represented map. -/
44: theorem w6_predecessor_range_decomposition {n d : Nat}
45:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (hXY : w6Precedes X Y) :
46:     LinearMap.range (transposeMap X) ⊓
47:         LinearMap.range (transposeMap (Y - X)) = ⊥ ∧
48:       LinearMap.range (transposeMap X) ⊔
49:         LinearMap.range (transposeMap (Y - X)) =
50:           LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y) := by
51:   let LX := transposeMap X
52:   let LY := transposeMap Y
53:   let LZ := transposeMap (Y - X)
54:   have hsum : LY = LX + LZ := by
55:     ext v i
56:     simp [LY, LX, LZ, transposeMap, Matrix.toLin'_apply,
57:       Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.sub_apply]
58:   have hRle : LinearMap.range LY ≤
59:       LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ := by
60:     have hleft : LinearMap.range LX ≤
61:         LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ := le_sup_left
62:     have hright : LinearMap.range LZ ≤
63:         LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ := le_sup_right
64:     intro z hz
65:     rcases hz with ⟨v, rfl⟩
66:     rw [hsum]
67:     change LX v + LZ v ∈ LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ
68:     apply add_mem
69:     · exact hleft (LinearMap.mem_range_self LX v)
70:     · exact hright (LinearMap.mem_range_self LZ v)
71:   have hdim : Module.finrank F ↥(LinearMap.range LY) =
72:       Module.finrank F ↥(LinearMap.range LX) +
73:         Module.finrank F ↥(LinearMap.range LZ) := by
74:     rw [transposeMap_rank, transposeMap_rank, transposeMap_rank]
75:     exact hXY
76:   have hsup_le : Module.finrank F
77:       ↥(LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ) ≤
78:         Module.finrank F ↥(LinearMap.range LX) +
79:           Module.finrank F ↥(LinearMap.range LZ) := by
80:     have h := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq
81:       (LinearMap.range LX) (LinearMap.range LZ)
82:     omega
83:   have hsup_dim : Module.finrank F
84:       ↥(LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ) =
85:         Module.finrank F ↥(LinearMap.range LY) := by
86:     have hmono := Submodule.finrank_mono hRle
87:     omega
88:   have hsum_eq : LinearMap.range LY =
89:       LinearMap.range LX ⊔ LinearMap.range LZ :=
90:     Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hRle hsup_dim.symm
91:   have hinf_dim : Module.finrank F
92:       ↥(LinearMap.range LX ⊓ LinearMap.range LZ) = 0 := by
93:     have h := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq
94:       (LinearMap.range LX) (LinearMap.range LZ)
95:     rw [hsup_dim] at h
96:     omega
97:   have hinf : LinearMap.range LX ⊓ LinearMap.range LZ = ⊥ :=
98:     (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero).mp hinf_dim
99:   exact ⟨hinf, hsum_eq.symm⟩

101: /-- The parent's kernel is contained in the predecessor's kernel.  This is
102: the well-definedness fact needed to descend `Xᵀ` to `range(Yᵀ)`. -/
103: theorem w6_predecessor_ker_le {n d : Nat}
104:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (hXY : w6Precedes X Y) :
105:     LinearMap.ker (transposeMap Y) ≤ LinearMap.ker (transposeMap X) := by
106:   have hsum : transposeMap Y = transposeMap X + transposeMap (Y - X) := by
107:     ext v i
108:     simp [transposeMap, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.transpose_sub,
109:       Matrix.sub_apply]
110:   have hdisj := (w6_predecessor_range_decomposition X Y hXY).1
111:   intro v hv
112:   apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
113:   have hzero := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv
114:   have hparts : transposeMap X v = -(transposeMap (Y - X) v) := by
115:     have := congrArg (fun z : V d => z) (hzero)
116:     rw [hsum, LinearMap.add_apply] at this
117:     exact (eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero).2 this
118:   have hx : transposeMap X v ∈ LinearMap.range (transposeMap X) :=
119:     LinearMap.mem_range_self (transposeMap X) v
120:   have hz : -(transposeMap (Y - X) v) ∈ LinearMap.range (transposeMap (Y - X)) :=
121:     (LinearMap.range (transposeMap (Y - X))).neg_mem
122:       (LinearMap.mem_range_self (transposeMap (Y - X)) v)
123:   have hboth : transposeMap X v ∈
124:       LinearMap.range (transposeMap X) ⊓ LinearMap.range (transposeMap (Y - X)) :=
125:     ⟨hx, by rw [hparts]; exact hz⟩
126:   have hbot : transposeMap X v = 0 := by
127:     have hm := hboth
128:     rw [hdisj] at hm
129:     simpa using hm
130:   exact hbot

132: private theorem w6_predecessor_range_le_parent {n d : Nat}
133:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (hXY : w6Precedes X Y) :
134:     LinearMap.range (transposeMap X) ≤ LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y) := by
135:   rw [← (w6_predecessor_range_decomposition X Y hXY).2]
136:   exact le_sup_left

138: /-- The predecessor map, with its codomain restricted to the parent's image.
139: This proof-level definition has no containment premise: that fact follows
140: from rank additivity. -/
141: def w6PredecessorRestrictedMap {n d : Nat}
142:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (hXY : w6Precedes X Y) :
143:     W n →ₗ[F] LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y) :=
144:   (transposeMap X).codRestrict (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y))
145:     (fun v => w6_predecessor_range_le_parent X Y hXY
146:       (LinearMap.mem_range_self (transposeMap X) v))

148: /-- Every rank-additive predecessor descends uniquely to an idempotent on the
149: parent image. Its range rank is the predecessor rank, and all facts are
150: derived from `w6Precedes`; no factorization or idempotence is a premise. -/
151: theorem w6_predecessor_descended_idempotent {n d : Nat}
152:     (X Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (hXY : w6Precedes X Y) :
153:     ∃! q : Module.End F (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y)),
154:       IsIdempotentElem q ∧
155:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range q) = X.rank ∧
156:         q.comp (LinearMap.rangeRestrict (transposeMap Y)) =
157:           w6PredecessorRestrictedMap X Y hXY := by
158:   classical
159:   let LX : W n →ₗ[F] V d := transposeMap X
160:   let LY : W n →ₗ[F] V d := transposeMap Y
161:   let LZ : W n →ₗ[F] V d := transposeMap (Y - X)
162:   let E : Submodule F (V d) := LinearMap.range LY
163:   let g : W n →ₗ[F] E := LinearMap.rangeRestrict LY
164:   let f : W n →ₗ[F] E := w6PredecessorRestrictedMap X Y hXY
165:   have hsum : LY = LX + LZ := by
166:     ext v i
167:     simp [LY, LX, LZ, transposeMap, Matrix.toLin'_apply,
168:       Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.sub_apply]
169:   have hsurj : Function.Surjective g := by
170:     intro z
171:     rcases z with ⟨z, hz⟩
172:     rcases hz with ⟨v, rfl⟩
173:     exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
174:   have hker : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker f := by
175:     intro v hv
176:     apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
177:     apply Subtype.ext
178:     have hYzero : LY v = 0 := by
179:       have h := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hv)
180:       exact h
181:     have hXzero := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp
182:       (w6_predecessor_ker_le X Y hXY (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hYzero))
183:     exact hXzero
184:   let e := g.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj
185:   let qbar := (LinearMap.ker g).liftQ f hker
186:   let q : Module.End F E := qbar.comp e.symm.toLinearMap
187:   have hfactor : q.comp g = f := by
188:     apply LinearMap.ext
189:     intro v
190:     change q (g v) = f v
191:     dsimp [q, qbar, e]
192:     rw [LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]
193:     rfl
194:   have hfix : ∀ z : E, z ∈ LinearMap.range f → q z = z := by
195:     intro z hz
196:     rcases hz with ⟨x, rfl⟩
197:     obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hsurj (f x)
198:     have hLYX : LY y = LX x := by
199:       have h₁ := congrArg Subtype.val hy
200:       have h₂ : (f x : V d) = LX x := rfl
201:       exact h₁.trans h₂
202:     have hparts : LX x - LX y = LZ y := by
203:       rw [← hLYX, hsum, LinearMap.add_apply]
204:       abel
205:     have hmemX : LX x - LX y ∈ LinearMap.range LX :=
206:       Submodule.sub_mem _ (LinearMap.mem_range_self LX x)
207:         (LinearMap.mem_range_self LX y)
208:     have hmemZ : LX x - LX y ∈ LinearMap.range LZ := by
209:       rw [hparts]
210:       exact LinearMap.mem_range_self LZ y
211:     have hboth : LX x - LX y ∈
212:         LinearMap.range LX ⊓ LinearMap.range LZ := ⟨hmemX, hmemZ⟩
213:     have hzero : LX x - LX y = 0 := by
214:       have hmem : LX x - LX y ∈ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) := by
215:         rw [(w6_predecessor_range_decomposition X Y hXY).1] at hboth
216:         exact hboth
217:       simpa using hmem
218:     have hXYval : LX y = LX x := (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm
219:     calc
220:       q (f x) = q (g y) := by rw [hy]
221:       _ = f y := by
222:         have h := congrArg (fun L : W n →ₗ[F] E => L y) hfactor
223:         simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
224:       _ = f x := by
225:         apply Subtype.ext
226:         exact hXYval
227:   have hqrange : LinearMap.range q ≤ LinearMap.range f := by
228:     rintro z ⟨u, rfl⟩
229:     obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj u
230:     refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
231:     have hqu : q u = f v := by
232:       calc
233:         q u = q (g v) := by rw [hv]
234:         _ = f v := by
235:           have h := congrArg (fun L : W n →ₗ[F] E => L v) hfactor
236:           simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
237:     exact hqu.symm
238:   have hrange : LinearMap.range q = LinearMap.range f := by
239:     apply le_antisymm hqrange
240:     rintro z ⟨v, rfl⟩
241:     refine ⟨g v, ?_⟩
242:     have h := congrArg (fun L : W n →ₗ[F] E => L v) hfactor
243:     simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
244:   have hIdem : IsIdempotentElem q := by
245:     apply LinearMap.ext
246:     intro z
247:     change q (q z) = q z
248:     apply hfix
249:     exact hqrange (LinearMap.mem_range_self q z)
250:   have hfrange : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range f) = X.rank := by
251:     have hcomp : E.subtype.comp f = LX := by
252:       ext v
253:       rfl
254:     have hmap : (LinearMap.range f).map E.subtype = LinearMap.range LX := by
255:       rw [← LinearMap.range_comp, hcomp]
256:     rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq E (LinearMap.range f), hmap,
257:       transposeMap_rank]
258:   have hqrank : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range q) = X.rank := by
259:     rw [hrange, hfrange]
260:   refine ⟨q, ⟨hIdem, hqrank, hfactor⟩, ?_⟩
261:   intro q' hq'
262:   rcases hq' with ⟨_, _, hfactor'⟩
263:   apply LinearMap.ext
264:   intro z
265:   obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj z
266:   calc
267:     q' z = q' (g v) := by rw [hv]
268:     _ = f v := by
269:       have h := congrArg (fun L : W n →ₗ[F] E => L v) hfactor'
270:       simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
271:     _ = q (g v) := by
272:       have h := congrArg (fun L : W n →ₗ[F] E => L v) hfactor
273:       simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h.symm
274:     _ = q z := by rw [hv]

276: /-- The transpose-map realization of an endomorphism of the parent's image.
277: This is the converse construction: restrict `Yᵀ` to its image, apply the
278: idempotent, and include the result back into the ambient coordinate space. -/
279: def w6IdempotentLiftMap {n d : Nat} (Y : BinaryMatrix n d)
280:     (q : Module.End F (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y))) :
281:     W n →ₗ[F] V d :=
282:   (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y)).subtype.comp
283:     (q.comp (LinearMap.rangeRestrict (transposeMap Y)))
284: 
285: /-- Convert a linear map `W n → V d` back to the manuscript's `n × d`
286: matrix convention. -/
287: def w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix {n d : Nat} (Y : BinaryMatrix n d)
288:     (q : Module.End F (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y))) : BinaryMatrix n d :=
289:   (LinearMap.toMatrix' (w6IdempotentLiftMap Y q)).transpose
290: 
291: private theorem transposeMap_w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix {n d : Nat}
292:     (Y : BinaryMatrix n d)
293:     (q : Module.End F (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y))) :
294:     transposeMap (w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix Y q) =
295:       w6IdempotentLiftMap Y q := by
296:   simp [transposeMap, w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix,
297:     Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
298: 
299: /-- Every idempotent on the parent image gives an actual rank-additive
300: predecessor. The rank identity is part of the conclusion, so this is a
301: genuine converse to the descended-idempotent construction. -/
302: theorem w6_idempotent_gives_predecessor {n d : Nat}
303:     (Y : BinaryMatrix n d)
304:     (q : Module.End F (LinearMap.range (transposeMap Y)))
305:     (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) :
306:     w6Precedes (w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix Y q) Y ∧
307:       (w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix Y q).rank =
308:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range q) := by
309:   classical
310:   let LY : W n →ₗ[F] V d := transposeMap Y
311:   let E : Submodule F (V d) := LinearMap.range LY
312:   let g : W n →ₗ[F] E := LinearMap.rangeRestrict LY
313:   let p : Module.End F E := LinearMap.id - q
314:   let X : BinaryMatrix n d := w6IdempotentPredecessorMatrix Y q

534: /-- Retractions onto a fixed subspace, represented as maps into that
535: subspace which fix it pointwise. -/
536: def W6Retraction (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
537:     (U : Submodule F E) :=
538:   {r : E →ₗ[F] U // ∀ u : U, r u = u}
539: 
540: noncomputable instance w6RetractionFintype (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
541:     [Fintype E] (U : Submodule F E) [Module.Free F U] [Module.Finite F U] :
542:     Fintype (W6Retraction E U) := by
543:   unfold W6Retraction
544:   exact Fintype.ofFinite _
545: 
546: /-- The affine space of retractions onto `U` is a torsor for maps from the
547: quotient by `U` into `U`. The chosen complement supplies an origin; the
548: translation vector is the unique map induced by `r - r₀`. -/
549: noncomputable def w6_retraction_quotient_equiv (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E]
550:     [Module F E] (U : Submodule F E) [Module.Free F U] [Module.Finite F U]
551:     [Finite E] : W6Retraction E U ≃ (E ⧸ U →ₗ[F] U) := by
552:   classical
553:   let C := Classical.choose U.exists_isCompl
554:   let hC : IsCompl U C := Classical.choose_spec U.exists_isCompl
555:   let e := U.prodEquivOfIsCompl C hC
556:   let r₀ : E →ₗ[F] U :=
557:     LinearMap.fst F U C ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap
558:   have hr₀ : ∀ u : U, r₀ u = u := by
559:     intro u
560:     simp [r₀, e, Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl_symm_apply_left]
561:   refine {
562:     toFun := fun r => U.liftQ (r.1 - r₀) ?_
563:     invFun := fun h => ⟨r₀ + h.comp U.mkQ, by
564:       intro u
565:       have hmk : U.mkQ (u : E) = 0 := by
566:         apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mp
567:         rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
568:         exact u.property
569:       simp [hr₀, hmk]⟩
570:     left_inv := ?_
571:     right_inv := ?_ }
572:   · intro u hu
573:     apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
574:     apply Subtype.ext
575:     simp [r.2 ⟨u, hu⟩, hr₀ ⟨u, hu⟩]
576:   · intro r
577:     apply Subtype.ext
578:     apply LinearMap.ext
579:     intro x
580:     simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
581:     have hvanish : U ≤ LinearMap.ker (r.1 - r₀) := by
582:       intro u hu
583:       apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
584:       apply Subtype.ext
585:       simp [r.2 ⟨u, hu⟩, hr₀ ⟨u, hu⟩]
586:     change r₀ x + U.liftQ (r.1 - r₀) hvanish (U.mkQ x) = r.1 x
587:     have hlift : U.liftQ (r.1 - r₀) hvanish (U.mkQ x) = (r.1 - r₀) x := by
588:       have hcomp := U.liftQ_mkQ (r.1 - r₀) hvanish
589:       exact congrArg (fun f : E →ₗ[F] U => f x) hcomp
590:     rw [hlift]
591:     simp
592:   · intro h
593:     apply LinearMap.ext
594:     intro x
595:     obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective U x
596:     simp [hr₀]

598: /-- The number of retractions onto a fixed `k`-dimensional subspace of a
599: `j`-dimensional finite binary space. This is the fixed-image factor in the
600: predecessor count; image enumeration is handled separately. -/
601: theorem w6_card_retractions {E : Type*} {k : Nat}
602:     [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
603:     [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
604:     (U : Submodule F E) [Module.Free F U] [Module.Finite F U]
605:     (hU : Module.finrank F U = k) :
606:     Fintype.card (W6Retraction E U) =
607:       2 ^ (k * (Module.finrank F E - k)) := by
608:   classical
609:   rw [Fintype.card_congr (w6_retraction_quotient_equiv E U)]
610:   rw [w6_card_linearMap_binary]
611:   have hquot := U.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
612:   have hdim : Module.finrank F (E ⧸ U) = Module.finrank F E - k := by
613:     rw [hU] at hquot
614:     omega
615:   rw [hdim, hU, Nat.mul_comm]
616: 
617: /-- Idempotents with a prescribed image `U` are counted by the same fixed
618: image factor, through Mathlib's actual idempotent-to-retraction equivalence. -/
619: def W6FixedRangeIdempotent (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
620:     (U : Submodule F E) :=
621:   {q : Module.End F E // IsIdempotentElem q ∧ LinearMap.range q = U}
622: 
623: noncomputable instance w6FixedRangeIdempotentFintype (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E]
624:     [Module F E] [Fintype E] (U : Submodule F E) :
625:     Fintype (W6FixedRangeIdempotent E U) := by
626:   unfold W6FixedRangeIdempotent
627:   exact Fintype.ofFinite _
628: 
629: theorem w6_card_fixed_range_idempotents {E : Type*} {k : Nat}
630:     [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E]
631:     [Fintype E] (U : Submodule F E) [Module.Free F U] [Module.Finite F U]
632:     (hU : Module.finrank F U = k) :
633:     Fintype.card (W6FixedRangeIdempotent E U) =
634:       2 ^ (k * (Module.finrank F E - k)) := by
635:   classical
636:   let e : W6FixedRangeIdempotent E U ≃ W6Retraction E U :=
637:     U.isIdempotentElemEquiv
638:   calc
639:     Fintype.card (W6FixedRangeIdempotent E U) =
640:         Fintype.card (W6Retraction E U) := Fintype.card_congr e
641:     _ = 2 ^ (k * (Module.finrank F E - k)) :=
642:       w6_card_retractions U hU

644: /-- The Grassmannian of actual subspaces of dimension `a`. -/
645: def W6Grass (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E] (a : Nat) :=
646:   {U : Submodule F E // Module.finrank F U = a}
647: 
648: instance w6GrassFinite (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
649:     [Fintype E] (a : Nat) : Finite (W6Grass E a) := by
650:   unfold W6Grass
651:   infer_instance
652: 
653: noncomputable instance w6GrassFintype (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E]
654:     [Module F E] [Fintype E] (a : Nat) : Fintype (W6Grass E a) :=
655:   Fintype.ofFinite _

657: /-- Ordered linearly independent frames. -/
658: def W6Frame (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E] (a : Nat) :=
659:   {v : Fin a → E // LinearIndependent F v}
660: 
661: instance w6FrameFinite (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
662:     [Fintype E] (a : Nat) : Finite (W6Frame E a) := by
663:   unfold W6Frame
664:   infer_instance
665: 
666: noncomputable instance w6FrameFintype (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E]
667:     [Module F E] [Fintype E] (a : Nat) : Fintype (W6Frame E a) :=
668:   Fintype.ofFinite _
669: 
670: /-- Number of ordered independent frames in an `n`-dimensional binary space. -/
671: def w6FrameProduct (n a : Nat) : Nat :=
672:   ∏ i : Fin a, (2 ^ n - 2 ^ i.val)
673: 
674: private def w6FlattenFrame {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
675:     (a : Nat) : (Σ U : W6Grass E a, W6Frame U.1 a) → W6Frame E a :=
676:   fun s => ⟨fun i => (s.2.1 i).1,
677:     s.2.2.map' s.1.1.subtype s.1.1.ker_subtype⟩
678: 
679: private theorem w6_span_flatten_frame {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
680:     [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E]
681:     {a : Nat} (U : W6Grass E a) (v : W6Frame U.1 a) :
682:     Submodule.span F (Set.range (w6FlattenFrame a ⟨U, v⟩).1) = U.1 := by
683:   apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
684:   · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
685:     rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
686:     exact (v.1 i).property
687:   · rw [finrank_span_eq_card (w6FlattenFrame a ⟨U, v⟩).property,
688:       Fintype.card_fin, U.2]
689: 
690: private theorem w6_flatten_frame_injective {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
691:     [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E]
692:     [Fintype E] (a : Nat) :
693:     Function.Injective (w6FlattenFrame (E := E) a) := by
694:   rintro ⟨U, v⟩ ⟨U', v'⟩ h
695:   have hUU : U = U' := by
696:     apply Subtype.ext
697:     rw [← w6_span_flatten_frame U v, ← w6_span_flatten_frame U' v', h]
698:   cases hUU
699:   have hvv : v = v' := by
700:     apply Subtype.ext
701:     funext i
702:     apply Subtype.ext
703:     exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) i
704:   cases hvv
705:   rfl
706: 
707: private theorem w6_flatten_frame_surjective {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
708:     [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E]
709:     [Fintype E] (a : Nat) :
710:     Function.Surjective (w6FlattenFrame (E := E) a) := by
711:   intro v
712:   let U : W6Grass E a := ⟨Submodule.span F (Set.range v.1), by
713:     simpa using finrank_span_eq_card v.2⟩
714:   let v' : W6Frame U.1 a :=
715:     ⟨fun i => ⟨v.1 i, Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩,
716:       linearIndependent_span v.2⟩
717:   exact ⟨⟨U, v'⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
718: 
719: /-- Choosing a subspace together with one of its bases is equivalent to
720: choosing an ambient independent frame. -/
721: private noncomputable def w6_frame_decomposition {E : Type*}
722:     [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E]
723:     [Fintype E] (a : Nat) :
724:     (Σ U : W6Grass E a, W6Frame U.1 a) ≃ W6Frame E a :=
725:   Equiv.ofBijective (w6FlattenFrame (E := E) a)
726:     ⟨w6_flatten_frame_injective a, w6_flatten_frame_surjective a⟩

728: private theorem w6_card_frame {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
729:     [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
730:     (a : Nat) (ha : a ≤ Module.finrank F E) :
731:     Fintype.card (W6Frame E a) =
732:       w6FrameProduct (Module.finrank F E) a := by
733:   have h := card_linearIndependent (K := F) (V := E) ha
734:   change Nat.card (W6Frame E a) = _ at h
735:   rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at h
736:   simpa [W6Frame, w6FrameProduct] using h
737: 
738: private theorem w6_card_internal_frame {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
739:     [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
740:     {a : Nat} (U : W6Grass E a) :
741:     Fintype.card (W6Frame U.1 a) = w6FrameProduct a a := by
742:   simpa [U.2] using (w6_card_frame (E := U.1) a (by rw [U.2]))

744: /-- Exact double count of subspaces by their ordered bases. -/
745: theorem w6_card_grass_mul {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
746:     [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
747:     (a : Nat) (ha : a ≤ Module.finrank F E) :
748:     Fintype.card (W6Grass E a) * w6FrameProduct a a =
749:       w6FrameProduct (Module.finrank F E) a := by
750:   classical
751:   have h := Fintype.card_congr (w6_frame_decomposition (E := E) a)
752:   rw [Fintype.card_sigma] at h
753:   have hsum : (∑ U : W6Grass E a, Fintype.card (W6Frame U.1 a)) =
754:       ∑ _U : W6Grass E a, w6FrameProduct a a := by
755:     apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
756:     intro U hU
757:     exact w6_card_internal_frame U
758:   rw [hsum] at h
759:   simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at h
760:   rw [w6_card_frame a ha] at h
761:   exact h

763: private theorem w6_frameProduct_self_pos (a : Nat) :
764:     0 < w6FrameProduct a a := by
765:   apply Finset.prod_pos
766:   intro i hi
767:   exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide : 1 < 2) i.isLt)

769: /-- Exact number of `a`-subspaces in an `n`-dimensional binary space, in
770: the frame-product form of the Gaussian binomial coefficient. -/
771: def w6Gaussian (n a : Nat) : Nat :=
772:   if a ≤ n then w6FrameProduct n a / w6FrameProduct a a else 0
773: 
774: theorem w6_card_grass_of_le {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
775:     [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
776:     (a : Nat) (ha : a ≤ Module.finrank F E) :
777:     Fintype.card (W6Grass E a) =
778:       w6FrameProduct (Module.finrank F E) a / w6FrameProduct a a := by
779:   rw [← w6_card_grass_mul a ha]
780:   exact (Nat.mul_div_left _ (w6_frameProduct_self_pos a)).symm
781: 
782: theorem w6_card_grass_of_lt {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
783:     [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
784:     {a : Nat} (ha : Module.finrank F E < a) :
785:     Fintype.card (W6Grass E a) = 0 := by
786:   letI : IsEmpty (W6Grass E a) := ⟨fun U => by
787:     have h := U.1.finrank_le
788:     rw [U.2] at h
789:     exact (not_le_of_gt ha) h⟩
790:   exact Fintype.card_eq_zero

792: theorem w6_card_grass {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E]
793:     [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E] (a : Nat) :
794:     Fintype.card (W6Grass E a) = w6Gaussian (Module.finrank F E) a := by
795:   by_cases ha : a ≤ Module.finrank F E
796:   · rw [w6Gaussian, if_pos ha, w6_card_grass_of_le a ha]
797:   · rw [w6Gaussian, if_neg ha,
798:       w6_card_grass_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge ha)]

800: /-- Rank-`k` idempotents partition by their actual image subspace. -/
801: private noncomputable def w6_idempotent_image_equiv {E : Type*}
802:     [AddCommGroup E] [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E]
803:     [Fintype E] (k : Nat) :
804:     {q : Module.End F E // IsIdempotentElem q ∧
805:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range q) = k} ≃
806:       Σ U : W6Grass E k, W6FixedRangeIdempotent E U.1 where
807:   toFun q :=
808:     ⟨⟨LinearMap.range q.1, q.2.2⟩, ⟨q.1, q.2.1, rfl⟩⟩
809:   invFun q :=
810:     ⟨q.2.1, q.2.2.1, by rw [q.2.2.2]; exact q.1.2⟩
811:   left_inv := by intro q; rfl
812:   right_inv := by
813:     rintro ⟨U, q⟩
814:     have hdim : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range q.1) = k := by
815:       rw [q.2.2]
816:       exact U.2
817:     let U' : W6Grass E k := ⟨LinearMap.range q.1, hdim⟩
818:     have hU : U' = U := by
819:       apply Subtype.ext
820:       exact q.2.2
821:     have hidx : U'.1 = U.1 := congrArg Subtype.val hU
822:     have hp : ∀ z : Module.End F E,
823:         (IsIdempotentElem z ∧ LinearMap.range z = U'.1) ↔
824:           (IsIdempotentElem z ∧ LinearMap.range z = U.1) := by
825:       intro z
826:       rw [hidx]
827:     refine Sigma.ext hU ?_
828:     exact (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_eq hp).2 rfl

830: /-- Actual rank-`k` idempotents on a `j`-dimensional finite binary space.
831: The count is obtained by enumerating each image and then its retractions. -/
832: theorem w6_card_rank_k_idempotents {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
833:     [Module F E] [Module.Free F E] [Module.Finite F E] [Fintype E]
834:     (k : Nat) :
835:     Fintype.card {q : Module.End F E // IsIdempotentElem q ∧
836:         Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range q) = k} =
837:       w6Gaussian (Module.finrank F E) k *
838:         2 ^ (k * (Module.finrank F E - k)) := by
839:   classical
840:   rw [Fintype.card_congr (w6_idempotent_image_equiv (E := E) k),
841:     Fintype.card_sigma]
842:   have hconst : ∀ U : W6Grass E k,
843:       Fintype.card (W6FixedRangeIdempotent E U.1) =
844:         2 ^ (k * (Module.finrank F E - k)) := by
845:     intro U
846:     have hU := U.2
847:     rw [w6_card_fixed_range_idempotents U.1 hU]
848:   simp_rw [hconst, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
849:     Nat.cast_id, w6_card_grass]

852: The Gaussian factor counts actual image subspaces; the power counts

/-- The dual coordinate map on frequencies is transposed because typed
frequencies run from the output carrier back to the input quotient. -/
def carrierFrequencyEquiv {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n)) :
    (B →ₗ[F] (V d ⧸ A)) ≃ₗ[F]
      BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B) (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A)) :=
  ((LinearEquiv.arrowCongr (codomainBasis B).equivFun
      (domainBasis A).equivFun).trans LinearMap.toMatrix').trans
    (Matrix.transposeLinearEquiv _ _ F F)

theorem carrierFrequency_toLin {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (Y : B →ₗ[F] (V d ⧸ A)) :
    (carrierFrequencyEquiv A B Y).transpose.toLin' =
      (domainBasis A).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp
        (Y.comp (codomainBasis B).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap) := by
  simp only [carrierFrequencyEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    Matrix.transposeLinearEquiv_apply]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [LinearEquiv.arrowCongr_apply]

    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :

        (M.comp (domainBasis A).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap) := by

    exact (domainBasis A).equivFun.apply_symm_apply x
  rw [hcoord] at h
  simpa [carrierMatrixEquiv] using h

coordinate equivalence, for every scalar-valued function on that carrier. -/
theorem carrierMean_coordinate {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (g : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Real) :
    carrierMean A B g =
      uniformMean (fun X => g ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)) := by
  unfold carrierMean BinaryMatrixFourier.uniformMean
  have hsum :

    intro M
    simp
  rw [hsum]
  congr 1
  exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_congr (carrierMatrixEquiv A B).toEquiv

    (g : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Complex) :
    carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq (g M)) =
      uniformMean (fun X =>
        Complex.normSq (g ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X))) := by
  exact carrierMean_coordinate A B (fun M => Complex.normSq (g M))

    simp [LinearEquiv.conj_apply]

  have hs :
      (∑ M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B,
        f M * (traceCharacter Y M : Complex)) =
      ∑ X : BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B) (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A)),
        f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) *
          (character (carrierFrequencyEquiv A B Y) X : Complex) := by
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (carrierMatrixEquiv A B).toEquiv
    intro M
    rw [carrierFrequency_character A B Y M]
    simp
  rw [hs]
  congr 1
  exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_congr (carrierMatrixEquiv A B).toEquiv

/-- Rank-j projection on the typed carrier is the actual coordinate rank-j
projection after transporting both input and its selected frequency set. -/
def carrierTypedComplexRankProjection {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (j : Nat) (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Complex)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) : Complex :=
  ∑ Y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (B →ₗ[F] (V d ⧸ A))).filter
      (fun Y => Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range Y) = j),
    complexCarrierFourierCoeff A B f Y * (traceCharacter Y M : Complex)

/-- The general-carrier rank projection is the same typed projection already
used by the A14 line and fixed-base statements. -/
theorem carrierTypedRankProjection_eq_A14Line {n d j : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Complex)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A B j f M =
      typedComplexRankProjection A B j f M := by
  rfl

theorem carrierTypedRankProjection_coordinate {n d j : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Complex)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A B j f M =
      complexRankProjection j
        (fun X => f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X))
        (carrierMatrixEquiv A B M) := by
  unfold carrierTypedComplexRankProjection complexRankProjection
  simp only [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (carrierFrequencyEquiv A B).toEquiv
  intro Y
  rw [← carrierFrequency_rank A B Y,
    carrierFourierCoeff_coordinate A B f Y,
    carrierFrequency_character A B Y M]
  simp

/-- Fourier support through D on typed carriers is equivalent to coordinate
Fourier support. The statement uses actual range ranks on both sides. -/
def CarrierComplexFourierSupportedThrough {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (D : Nat) (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Complex) : Prop :=
  ∀ Y : B →ₗ[F] (V d ⧸ A),
    D < Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range Y) ->
      complexCarrierFourierCoeff A B f Y = 0

theorem carrierFourier_support_iff_coordinate {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n)) (D : Nat)
    (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) -> Complex) :
    CarrierComplexFourierSupportedThrough A B D f ↔
      ComplexFourierSupportedThrough D
        (fun X => f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf Y hY
    let Z := (carrierFrequencyEquiv A B).symm Y
    have hZ : D < Module.finrank F
        (LinearMap.range ((carrierFrequencyEquiv A B).symm Y)) := by
      rw [← carrierFrequency_rank A B ((carrierFrequencyEquiv A B).symm Y)]
      simpa [Z] using hY
    have hzero := hf ((carrierFrequencyEquiv A B).symm Y) hZ
    rw [carrierFourierCoeff_coordinate A B f] at hzero
    simpa [Z] using hzero
  · intro hf Y hY
    have hzero := hf (carrierFrequencyEquiv A B Y) (by
      simpa [carrierFrequency_rank] using hY)
    rw [← carrierFourierCoeff_coordinate A B f Y] at hzero
    exact hzero

end
